chunks: And when We took from the prophets their covenant, and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, son of Mary, and We took from them a firm covenant.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'firm covenant' taken from the prophets in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Al-Mithaq al-Ghaliz* (the Firm Covenant), signifying the collective pledge of all prophets to confirm and follow Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). It underscores the continuity of divine guidance and the unique status of the Prophet as the seal of the prophetic line, reinforcing the theological basis for his authority and the unity of the prophetic mission.
